_comment: The screens of the ethereal spawn. pos is the middle block; facing is the way the front points (towards the middle of the platform); pages are text (see docs/cinema-screens.md). After editing, run /conflux dimension spawndecor to rebuild them.

pages:
THREE PATHS
Three disciplines are open to you. Each is a way of working, and each shapes the machines, materials and research you will have.

HOW THESE SCREENS WORK
Click a button to use it, or the arrows to turn the page. Right-click anywhere else on a screen to go to the next page.

WHERE TO GO
Read the screens on each side: what the Conflux is, what research costs, and the three paths. When you are ready, use the choosing screen in front of you.

THE CONFLUX
A body of knowledge that grows as you work, and a place that answers to it.

ONE FOR YOUR TEAM
Your team has one Conflux. Whatever one of you researches, all of you have.

TREES OF RESEARCH
Each discipline is a tree. Finishing a node opens new recipes, machines or abilities for your whole team.

GATES
Some things stay locked until the Conflux teaches them: a recipe, or a multiblock you cannot form yet.

ARCANE DATA
Arcane data only exists when Ars Nouveau is installed.

MAKING DATA
Data-producer machines make it. Spend it at a research terminal, on the nodes of your path.

WHAT YOU NEED
Each discipline leans on different kinds, so what you build first depends on what you choose.

WHAT YOU DO
You work with fire, heat and raw energy: forges, reactors, and reactions that burn hot.

ITS RESEARCH
It opens through Ember Awakening and leads to The Pyre, where you commit.

CHOOSE IT IF
You want power and speed, and do not mind handling a lot of heat.

CHANGING YOUR MIND
Costs energetic and material data.

WHAT YOU DO
You work with living systems: growth, sensing, signals, and information that spreads.

ITS RESEARCH
It opens through First Contact and leads to The Joining, where you commit.

CHOOSE IT IF
You like patient, sprawling builds and machines that sense and respond.

CHANGING YOUR MIND
Costs biological and material data.

WHAT YOU DO
You work with space and computation: storage, distance, odd geometry and the arcane.

ITS RESEARCH
It opens through First Silence and leads to The Inversion, where you commit.

CHOOSE IT IF
You like logistics, dimensions and precise control.

CHANGING YOUR MIND
Costs computational and arcane data.

COMMITTING
Every path has a commitment node: The Pyre, The Joining, The Inversion.

WHAT IT DOES
Researching it commits you to the path, and the research that follows it is built on that.

CHANGING AFTERWARDS
You can still change path, but it costs ten times the data of changing before you commit, and you lose the research of the path you leave.

BE SURE
Read the paths again if you are not.

AFTER YOU CHOOSE
You are taken to the realm of your discipline.

YOUR QUESTBOOK
It has a chapter for your path, and the first quests tell you where to begin.

COMING BACK
Return here any time with /conflux dimension return.

GOOD LUCK
The Conflux is listening.

WHAT EACH ONE DOES
The quest book: your quests and what to do next. The map: your surroundings and waypoints. Research: your tree of research and your data. The star map: bodies, missions and personal dimensions.

MOVING THEM
You can drag the buttons to where you like. The settings button at the end of the bar lets you show or hide each one, change their size, and put them all back where they started.

TRY IT
Open your inventory now (E) and find them. The quest book is the best first stop: it has a chapter for the path you choose.

THE STAR MAP
Open it from the HUD bar. Pick a body, see its details, and send a mission there.

PERSONAL DIMENSIONS
Space you make yourself: the Continuum builds a pocket world around the body you choose.
